whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Cathy Confectioners,

I noticed your bakery has established 3.9★ reviews in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering page for custom cakes and home delivery inquiries.

Maine aapki bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, birthday/anniversary menu, aur location guide integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/cathy

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Cathy Confectioners team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and a showcase of your sweet treats right in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
